Group rides in North Dakota

6 recurring group rides around North Dakota: 4 road, 1 mountain bike, 1 gravel. 6 roll on weeknights, 0 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Great Northern Monday Riding 101 Ride in Fargo — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Great Northern W.O.W. (Women on Wheels) Road Ride runs 15–18 mph.
